opening.argument: The interview centers on developer infrastructure and enterprise stablecoin operations. A speaker describes a platform that helps financial institutions, enterprises, and fintechs integrate stablecoins into their flows, then discusses custody-model flexibility and an example of distributing employer funds to a global workforce. These are explanations of platform capabilities and an enterprise use case, not a request for viewers to transfer money, provide credentials, or expect investment returns. The interview setting and the description's educational framing support an informational reading; the statement presents no offer or solicitation.
